title: Database Schema & TypeScript Contracts Foundation
description: Establishes the database schema foundation and TypeScript contract definitions that all subsequent FEATs depend on.
completed_items: ✓ Database schema already includes all required models: Subscription, SubscriptionPlan, Tournament, AuctionRoom, RoomSettings, RoomMember, AuctionTeam, RoomInvitation, RoomAccessPolicy
✓ All models have proper foreign keys and relationships defined
✓ Indexes present on critical paths: (roomId, userId), (roomId, code), (userId, planId), (visibility, listed, status)
✓ Financial fields use BigInt for minor units (paisa), no floating-point
✓ Created subscriptions.contract.ts with SubscriptionDto, SubscriptionPlanDto, EntitlementCheckDto
✓ Created rooms.contract.ts with RoomDto, RoomSettingsDto, RoomMemberDto, AuctionTeamDto, AllocationResultDto
✓ Created index.ts to export all contracts
✓ All contracts are type-safe with explicit types (no `any`)

models_verified: SubscriptionPlan: id, key, name, priceMinor, currency, period, active, createdAt
Subscription: id, userId (FK User), planId (FK SubscriptionPlan), status, currentPeriodStart, currentPeriodEnd, cancelAtPeriodEnd, createdAt, updatedAt
Tournament: id, organizerId (FK User), name, description, entryFeeEnabled, entryFeeMinor, createdAt, updatedAt
AuctionRoom: id, tournamentId (FK Tournament), hostId (FK User), name, status, visibility, listed, currentSettingsVersion, createdAt, updatedAt
RoomSettings: id, roomId (FK AuctionRoom), version, config (Json), createdAt - with @@unique([roomId, version])
RoomMember: id, roomId (FK AuctionRoom), userId (FK User), role, status, joinedAt, leftAt - with @@unique([roomId, userId, role]) and indexes
AuctionTeam: id, auctionId (FK Auction), teamId (FK Team), slotIndex, allocationMethod, purseInitialMinor, purseBalanceMinor, createdAt - with @@unique constraints
RoomInvitation: id, roomId (FK AuctionRoom), createdById (FK User), inviteeUserId (FK User nullable), role, codeHash (unique), expiresAt, maxUses, useCount, createdAt
RoomAccessPolicy: roomId (PK FK AuctionRoom), joinPolicy, spectatorPolicy, teamOwnerCapacity, spectatorCapacity, lateJoinPolicy, spectatorChatEnabled, externalLinksEnabled

contracts_created.exports: All contract files exported from single entry point

warnings: Prisma CLI could not be executed directly in this environment to generate a formal migration
Workaround: Schema already exists and is well-formed; can generate migration in next phase when Prisma tooling is available
notes: All models required by FEAT-001 already exist in the schema
Schema is modular (domain-based) and built by build-schema.mjs script
Models follow AGENTS.md requirements: proper FKs, BigInt for money, no hardcoded values
All contracts follow TypeScript strict mode: no `any` types
Contracts are DTOs (data transfer objects) for API and frontend/backend communication
No hardcoded team counts or league presets in schema
Host subscription model enables entitlements-based access control
